title: 🚗 Tesla’s Cybercab Starts Public Rides in Dallas!
body: 🚗 Tesla’s Cybercab Starts Public Rides in Dallas!

Tesla began public rides with its self-driving “Cybercab” in Dallas on November 19, 2026, making it the second city after Austin, and welcomed riders with the phrase “Howdy Dallas.” The car runs version “v1.5,” fitted with a Starlink dish on the rear roof and a camera in the trunk lid; it is a two-seat car with no steering wheel or pedals, booked through the Robotaxi app, covering a service area of about 81 square miles. Tesla also announced a private purchase price of $29,990 with a $299 monthly autonomy subscription, with deliveries starting in December, while more than 300 Cybercabs operate in Austin.
Simply put: a taxi with no driver and no steering wheel at all; you order it from an app, and it comes to you and takes you there by itself.
Would you ride in a car with no driver?
